relationships.subject: fremanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: After fremanezumab treatment, the fraction of trigeminal ganglion neurons which were immunoreactive to CGRP and the CGRP receptor components calcitonin receptor-like receptor (CLR) and receptor activity modifying protein 1 (RAMP1) was significantly lowered compared to the control.

relationships.subject: fremanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: The content and concentration of CGRP in trigeminal ganglia were not significantly changed.

key_findings: Fremanezumab reduced the fraction of trigeminal neurons immunoreactive for CGRP, RAMP1 and CLR (not RCP) without changing ganglion CGRP content.
